## Design note

A semi tractor running bobtail: no trailer, so nearly nine tonnes with most of it on the steer axle and a light, skittish tandem that spins up in the low gears. It pulls hard once rolling, tops out at the fleet governor and needs a football pitch to stop. In traffic it is a moving wall; in a pursuit it is the thing you do not want to meet at a junction.

## How this car breaks

Two deep steel frame rails run bumper to fifth wheel, so frontal and rear hits bend the bumper, grille and long fibreglass hood while the frame shrugs. The sleeper cab is tall and not crash-structured like a car — hits above frame height go straight in. Side-saddle fuel tanks hang outboard of the rails between the axles; the steer axle and its tires are the soft spot.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2010s conventional sleeper tractors (bobtail weights)
- manufacturer spec-class data for 12.8-13 L heavy-duty diesel sixes
- engineering tables (commercial tire radius, air-suspension ride frequency, S-cam air brake torque)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

## Drivetrain

12-speed automated manual (dry clutch), open inter-axle and rear diffs on the tandem; top speed set by the limiter in 12th (fleet governor). Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 3220 N·m. Shift time 0.50 s.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.28 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 2365 kg | 1.60 Hz | 239100 N/m | 13320 N·s/m | 19980 N·s/m | 0.18 m |
| Rear | 1324 kg | 1.60 Hz | 133800 N/m | 7450 N·s/m | 11180 N·s/m | 0.20 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 4.0°/g with 60% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 1.004 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 1240707 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 517125 F / 223983 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **52500 F / 81300 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 4.0°/g, front share 60%. Bump stops 2000000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Air brakes: full-application chamber pressure 6.9 bar.

- Front: 419 mm air S-cam drum, type-24 chamber (A = 155 cm²), 140 mm slack adjuster, cam gain 8.5 (drum torque / camshaft torque, includes lining μ): T = p·A·L·G = 6.9 bar·155 cm²·0.140 m·8.5 = 12714 N·m per wheel end = **12714 N·m**
- Rear: 419 mm air S-cam drum, type-30 chamber (A = 194 cm²), 140 mm slack adjuster, cam gain 8.0 (drum torque / camshaft torque, includes lining μ): T = p·A·L·G = 6.9 bar·194 cm²·0.140 m·8.0 = 14957 N·m per wheel end × 2 ends (tandem lumped into one physics wheel) = **29915 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 17526 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.73×), rear needs 3477 N·m/wheel (capacity 8.60×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 2522 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.922** → delivered 12710 N·m front / 2530 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 14960 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 22.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 15.5 m → outer-front path radius 7.60 m, rear-axle-centre radius 5.09 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.724 rad (41.5°)** (outer 36.3°, inner 48.0° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.80). Rack speed 0.9 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/longhaul_tractor.json`)

328 nodes, 2016 beams, 6 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id longhaul_tractor --profile truck --width 2.5 --length 6.9 --height 3.4 --wheelbase 4.5 --mass 1935.5 --car-mass 8797.9 --clearance 0.4 --front-overhang 1.15 --strength 1.3` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 5).
- Era `2010s`: gen-lattice's default HSS passenger cell kept as is.
- Steel hood: 159 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 180 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Body-on-frame: 18 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 16 under-cab rail beams → hss 1.39e-03 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Side-saddle fuel tank outboard of the left frame rail between cab and rear axle.
